strategies.desc: Directly implements the reference pattern with 6 all-reduce dispatches (1 initial sum + 5 dependent iterations). Each all-reduce operates on the full (8*256,) tensor. Represents the straightforward interpretation with 6 network round-trips but minimal local computation complexity.

strategies.name: Fused scaling factor broadcast pattern
strategies.desc: After computing block means and ReLU locally, concatenate all 8 scaling factors into a single (8,) tensor and all-reduce it separately from data. Uses 12 total dispatches (6 for data all-reduces + 6 for factor all-reduces) but enables parallel computation of local block statistics before synchronization, potentially hiding latency.

strategies.name: Block-wise reduce-scatter then all-gather
strategies.desc: Replace each all-reduce with a reduce-scatter (split 8 blocks among rank subsets) followed by local scaling computation on owned blocks, then all-gather to reconstruct full tensor. Uses 12 dispatches (6 RS + 6 AG) with smaller per-operation payloads (256 elements per block instead of 2048), trading dispatch count for reduced bandwidth per collective.

strategies.name: Vectorized block operations with single buffer
strategies.desc: Pre-allocate a single contiguous buffer for all 6 iterations, compute all local scaling factors as an (8,) vector per iteration, and apply block-wise scaling using strided tensor views without explicit loops. Still 6 all-reduce dispatches but fuses all 8 block operations per iteration into vectorized operations, reducing kernel launch overhead.

strategies.name: Hierarchical two-stage reduction with node-local aggregation
strategies.desc:
Exploit num_nodes structure by first performing intra-node all-reduce (among cores_per_device * num_devices ranks per node), then inter-node all-reduce on node leaders, then broadcast back. Each of 6 dependent steps uses 3 collectives (intra-node AR, inter-node AR, intra-node broadcast) for 18 total dispatches, but reduces cross-node bandwidth by factor of ranks-per-node.
